entries.grounds: review_verify.py:122 `except (ContractError, ValueError, TypeError) as e`; the mutant drops element 0. aisef2/product/contract.py:26 `class ContractError(ValueError)`: every ContractError instance is a ValueError, matched by element 1 into the same handler, the same `e`, the same returned f-string (:123).
